summary.tldr: Requires more public disclosure about corporate controllers, while protecting some personal information and expanding enforcement under the Canada Business Corporations Act.
what_it_does: Requires the Director under the Canada Business Corporations Act to make certain information about individuals with significant control over a corporation public.
Protects the information and identity of certain individuals.
Adds or broadens offences, and gives the Director more enforcement and compliance powers.
Gives power to make regulations setting further requirements for some provisions.
Makes consequential and related amendments to other Acts.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Business Corporations Act and makes related changes to other Acts.
